summary: New subject after the first surrogate result. Test whether a preregistered bounded-composition compatibility gate can accept a safe orthogonal adapter pair while rejecting a deliberately conflicting pair, without post-hoc thresholds or answer-key-like routing information.
hypothesis: A simple development-only compatibility gate based on predeclared mixed-task gain plus component-regression ceilings can distinguish safe sparse adapter composition from destructive composition.
kill_condition: If the gate cannot reject the conflicting pair without post-hoc thresholds or privileged labels, kill RDME_V2 composition and prefer serial/context decomposition or simpler H1/H2.
